# Generated files — do not edit

`catalogue.json`, `sizecharts.json`, `prices.json` and `care-icons.json` are
generated from `data/lemon-soda.db` by `scripts/build-data.mjs`.

`npm run dev` and `npm run build` regenerate them first, so anything you change
here is overwritten. To change the data, change the database.

They are committed so the project is readable and diffable on GitHub, and so
you can see exactly what the site bundles.

`nav.ts` beside them is **not** generated — it is hand-written navigation
configuration.
